mods.name: Better ToggleSneak
mods.description: Keep toggle sneak in chat and pause menus; release it for inventories and resume on close.

releases.notes:
Better ToggleSneak **1.1.0** for **Minecraft 26.2 / Fabric**.

### Updated behavior

- **Chat, Esc/pause, and options:** keep toggle sneak active.
- **Your inventory and server-managed containers** (chests, furnaces, anvils, trading, mounted inventories): temporarily release sneak.
- **When you close the inventory/container:** resume sneaking automatically if sneak was active before opening it.
- Mouse-bound sneak now also resumes correctly. Hold mode and other keybindings retain normal behavior.
- Other screens use normal release-and-restore behavior.

### Packet verification

Tests record packets in a real Minecraft 26.2 client/integrated-server connection. Empty chat and Esc have no dedicated screen-open packet. Personal inventory also has no dedicated opening packet, but **displaying newly unlocked recipes can send recipe-seen packets**, and closing it sends a container-close packet. That is why this version also releases sneak in personal inventory.

The tests verify the chest interaction/open packets, sneak=false while containers are open, and sneak=true after closing. They also cover server-opened furnace/anvil/merchant menus, mouse bindings, and an initially inactive toggle remaining off.

See the [full packet audit](https://github.com/Merkie/better-toggle-sneak/blob/main/docs/packet-audit.md).

### Install

Replace the previous Better ToggleSneak JAR in your `mods` folder with `better-toggle-sneak-1.1.0+26.2.jar`. Requires Fabric Loader **0.19.3+**, Minecraft **26.2**, and Java **25**. Enable **Sneak: Toggle** in Accessibility Settings. Client only; Fabric API is not required.

releases.notes:
Better ToggleSneak for **Minecraft 26.2 / Fabric**.

With **Options → Accessibility Settings → Sneak: Toggle**, stay sneaking while inventory, containers, chat, pause, and other menus are open. Press the sneak key again after returning to gameplay to stop.

- Supports rebound keyboard and mouse buttons.
- Preserves normal Hold mode and other keybindings.
- Clears sneak on death/respawn and disconnect.
- Client only. Requires Fabric Loader 0.19.3 or newer and Java 25. Fabric API is not required.

**Install:** put `better-toggle-sneak-1.0.0+26.2.jar` in your Minecraft instance's `mods` folder.

Built and verified with a real Minecraft 26.2 client game test covering screens, client/server sneak input, explicit untoggling, keyboard/mouse rebinding, Hold mode, death/reset, and reconnect.
